usageNotes: Use this to review the changelog of an installed or available APT package on a specific node before applying updates, helping you assess risk. The target node must be online and reachable by the API. Requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}, which is a privileged permission — API tokens scoped to read-only roles will be denied.

examples.summary: Fetch the changelog for the proxmox-ve meta-package on node pve1

tips: Omitting 'version' returns the changelog for the currently available (candidate) version from the APT cache.
The response is a plain-text string (the raw Debian changelog), not JSON — handle it as a text blob.
Run get_nodes_node_apt_update first to refresh the package index so the returned changelog reflects the latest available version.
Package names must match the Debian naming pattern (lowercase, digits, hyphens, plus, dots, colons) — invalid names will be rejected.
